title: In This World Dogs Speak One Sentence A Year
description: Rin's old dog Mochi gets one sentence on the night of the first snow, and Grandpa says old dogs use the last one to say goodbye. What would your pet say with one sentence? #anime #shorts #animestory #retroanime

characters.Rin: 12-year-old Japanese girl, straight black chin-length bob with a single plain blue hairclip, oversized cream knit cardigan over a navy turtleneck, gray sweatpants, thick white socks, no hat
characters.Mochi: 13-year-old medium-sized Shiba Inu dog, cream and orange fur, gray around the muzzle and eyebrows, soft brown eyes, plain red cloth collar with no tag, no clothes
characters.Grandpa Tetsu: 74-year-old Japanese grandfather, short gray crew cut, deep laugh lines, brown knit vest over a white collared shirt, dark brown trousers, house slippers, no hat, no glasses

scenes.say: In this world, dogs get to speak one sentence a year, on the night of the first snow. Rin's dog Mochi has used twelve, and almost all were about ham.
scenes.video: [0-4s] Outside a small 1990s Japanese house at night, the first soft snowflakes fall past a warm lit window. [4-7s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, in the tatami living room, Mochi sits on a cushion and looks up with his mouth slightly open while Rin leans in close, eager. [7-10s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, close-up of Mochi licking his lips and glancing toward the small kitchen fridge.

scenes.say: Year one: your feet smell like treasure. Year four: the mailman is a spy. Year nine: more ham, please. Rin wrote every one inside her school notebook.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, in the tatami living room, little puppy Mochi sniffs a small child's sock-covered foot, tail wagging. [4-7s] At the front gate of the same small 1990s Japanese house in daytime, Mochi growls with narrowed eyes at a plain mail bag left on the step. [7-10s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, in a small bedroom, Rin smiles and gently closes a plain notebook, hugging it to her chest.

scenes.say: But this winter Mochi is thirteen, gray around the nose, and slow on the stairs. Grandpa says old dogs usually save their last sentence to say goodbye.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, on the narrow wooden stairs, Mochi climbs one step at a time while Rin waits above, worried. [4-7s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, close-up of Mochi's gray muzzle resting on his paws on a cushion. [7-10s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, in the small kitchen, Grandpa Tetsu speaks gently to Rin, one hand on her shoulder, while she looks at the floor.

scenes.say: So when the first snow starts falling, Rin doesn't want to hear it. She sits up by the kotatsu with him, hands over her ears, hoping midnight never comes.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, Rin looks out the living room window at snow falling on a dark garden, her face tightening. [4-7s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, under the warm kotatsu table in the dim tatami living room, Rin sits with Mochi curled against her, both hands pressed over her ears. [7-10s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, close-up of Rin's teary eyes in the orange kotatsu glow, Mochi's ear twitching beside her.

scenes.say: But Mochi paws at her sleeve until she lowers her hands. The clock hits twelve. He looks at the fridge, then at her, and opens his mouth.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, at the kotatsu in the tatami living room, close-up of Mochi's paw tapping Rin's cardigan sleeve. [4-7s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, Rin slowly lowers her hands from her ears and looks down at him, holding her breath. [7-10s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, close-up of Mochi looking toward the small kitchen fridge, then turning his soft brown eyes to Rin and opening his mouth.

scenes.say: 'More ham. Same spot next year.' Rin laughs so hard she cries, and gets the ham. In this world, dogs speak one sentence a year, and Mochi plans ahead.
scenes.video: [0-4s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, at the kotatsu, close-up of Mochi speaking with a serious little face. [4-7s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, Rin bursts out laughing with tears on her cheeks and hugs Mochi tight, while Grandpa Tetsu peeks in from the doorway smiling. [7-10s] inside a small 1990s Japanese house, in the small kitchen lit by the open fridge, Rin hands Mochi a slice of ham, his tail wagging, snow falling outside the window.
